{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

print("\nData types:")
print(data.dtypes)

print("\nMissing values (nulls):")
print(data.isnull().sum())

print("\nUnique values in each column:")
for col in data.columns:
    print(f"{col}: {data[col].nunique()} unique values")
    print(f"  Examples: {data[col].drop_duplicates().sample(5).values}")

# Check for sentinel values
print("\nValues of -1 in customer_age:")
print(data[data['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count())

# Check for QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue = 999999.99):")
print(data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:")
print(data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])"}
